content.short: Trusta is a decentralized reputation and identity protocol providing AI-driven credit scoring and Sybil detection.
content.description:
Trusta is a pioneering decentralized identity and reputation protocol designed to quantify and verify on-chain behavior for Web3 users and AI agents. The platform features the "MEDIA Score," a comprehensive metric that assesses reputation based on Monetary value, Engagement levels, Diversity of interactions, Identity verification, and Age of the account. This allows projects to distinguish high-quality human participants from bots and Sybil attackers in a transparent and verifiable manner.

By utilizing advanced AI and machine learning algorithms, Trusta provides developers with robust tools such as TrustScan for proactive risk management and user profiling. The protocol serves as a foundational layer for the decentralized economy, empowering participants to build their digital legacy and access exclusive benefits based on their verifiable impact. Through its commitment to meritocratic rewards and data-driven security, Trusta is building the essential framework for a more secure and trustworthy digital future, where reputation is a globally accessible and verifiable asset.
content.meta: Trusta provides AI-powered on-chain reputation scoring and Sybil detection tools for decentralized identity.
